up: Find IC50 activity records for the compound tylophorine (including its salt forms and derivatives) when tested in the RAW264.7 cell line. The query should identify tylophorine using its preferred name or synonyms from the molecule dictionary and hierarchy tables. For the cell line, match against the cell name in the cell dictionary (e.g., 'RAW 264.7' or 'RAW264.7'). Return the ChEMBL ID of the compound, the standard IC50 value, the standard units, the assay ID, the document ID, the activity comment, the standard relation, the pChEMBL value, the assay description, and the assay organism.
sql:
WITH tylophorine_compounds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT md.molregno, md.chembl_id
  FROM molecule_dictionary md
  LEFT JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.molregno = md.molregno
  LEFT JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh_parent ON mh.parent_molregno = md.molregno
  LEFT JOIN molecule_synonyms ms ON ms.molregno = md.molregno
  WHERE LOWER(md.pref_name) LIKE '%tylophorine%'
     OR LOWER(ms.synonyms) LIKE '%tylophorine%'
     OR mh.parent_molregno IN (
         SELECT parent.molregno 
         FROM molecule_dictionary parent 
         WHERE LOWER(parent.pref_name) LIKE '%tylophorine%'
       )
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  tc.chembl_id,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.assay_id,
  a.doc_id,
  a.activity_comment,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.pchembl_value,
  ass.description,
  ass.assay_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN cell_dictionary cd ON ass.cell_id = cd.cell_id
JOIN tylophorine_compounds tc ON a.molregno = tc.molregno
WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND (cd.cell_name LIKE '%RAW264.7%' OR cd.cell_name LIKE '%RAW 264.7%');
